dialogues.speaker: Kagawa
dialogues.text: Well... Come to think of it, I did see some rare Magical Crystal Ore while training around these parts. They say that the quality of these is a fair shade superior to those of ordinary ore.

dialogues.speaker: Kagawa
dialogues.text: That said, I don't do any metalworking, so they're of little use to me. I think they were around here... There we go, I've marked it out on your map.

dialogues.speaker: Kagawa
dialogues.text: Remember to enjoy the scenery while you're on the way there!
